quality_notes: ONS territorial, residence or production, and consumption or footprint accounting bases remain explicitly separate.
ONS revised, corrected and current dataset editions preserve publication and method status rather than silently replacing prior semantics.
DfT SAF and RTFO fifth-provisional 2025 data remain provisional; future final releases are not treated as observed.
DfT vehicle licensing and EV charging infrastructure remain stock, activity or infrastructure evidence rather than direct greenhouse-gas measurements.
Ofgem BUS applications, vouchers, grants, eligibility and guidance remain administration or policy evidence rather than measured emissions reductions.
DESNZ conversion factors and UK ETS factors remain calculation/reporting tools; allowances and market information remain compliance or market evidence rather than physical parcel emissions.
DESNZ local-authority and National Data Library surfaces remain aggregate evidence and are not assigned to individual parcels.
ONS energy-use datasets preserve fuel, industry, source, unit and denominator semantics and are not converted into parcel emissions without a supported binding method.
Official-page licence, attribution and dataset-version provenance are explicitly guarded where exposed.
Publication date, reference period, provisional/final state, stock/flow, geography, method version and pollutant/GHG distinctions remain explicit.
Web HTML bytes were not downloaded or content-hashed; source_content_hash_status remains NOT_COMPUTED_WEB_HTML_REFERENCE_ONLY.
No unsupported conversion, future-release observation, policy-to-measurement substitution or individual parcel emissions value was inferred or produced.
